prompt_fragment: This asset is a card face. Compose for a vertical 3:4 frame with a strong focal subject and room for card framing or overlay treatment.
raw_description:
Upper half: a Before Times relic in a deep vault — impossible shard on a
carved volcanic-glass pedestal, serial numbers ("8H-H1Y0B") faintly
phosphorescent on its face. Aurora-crystal shards arranged in a warding
pattern around it. Robed ice-readers watch from a safe distance, one with
a shaking hand raised. A halo of cold wrongness around the relic.
Lower half: warm dark surface for text with a ghosted serial-number
watermark. Warm cream parchment frame.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor field-journal plate, a fractured Before Times relic on a carved volcanic-glass pedestal inside a crystalline vault, robed penguin ice-readers watching from shadow, warm vellum cream frame with slate ink shadow and a cold prismatic halo at the shard's edges.

subjects.description: Impossible angular shard, phosphorescent serial numbers '8H-H1Y0B' faintly lit on its face, aurora-crystal shards in warding formation on volcanic-glass pedestal, cold prismatic shimmer emanating outward

Lean adult emperor penguins in pale ice-plate and flowing white robes, aurora-crystal coronets, one figure extends a trembling hand toward the relic, rank script inscribed into segmented silvered plate
subjects.position: mid-ground flanking, receding into slate shadow

subjects.description: Lower third: warm deep volcanic-glass surface with ghosted '8H-H1Y0B' watermark, prismatic lens architecture framing the vault ceiling above, aged parchment border with faint foxing
